verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents invoicing, payment collection, a Clients API, and a Reports API whose seven report types include Invoice Details and Payments Collected, so receivables data is tracked and reportable. Nothing in the evidence explicitly names an AR aging report or per-customer outstanding-balance views. missing for 10: explicit accounts-aging report, per-customer balance/statement view, documented AR-specific reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
